entities.summary: "Sing for Absolution" is a song by English rock band Muse, serving as the title track for their third studio album, Absolution (2003). It was released in May 2004 as the fourth single from that album, peaking at number 16 in the UK Singles Chart. The song also appears on the Absolution Tour DVD. A live acoustic version of the song serves as a B-side for the "Butterflies and Hurricanes" single.
